items.title: Product Monday: Venetian Blinds Upcycled Into Luminaires
items.summary: Designer Reza Raeisifar's Keker Collection repurposes discarded aluminium Venetian blind slats into cylindrical luminaires, illustrating circular-economy approaches to shaping and diffusing light with reclaimed materials.

items.title: London Aquatics Centre upgrades to next-generation LED lighting with Signify
items.summary: Signify replaced the London Aquatics Centre's lighting with an LED system meeting World Aquatics broadcast requirements, claiming up to 60% energy savings at full output and using AR-assisted aiming for installation accuracy.

items.title: Showlight comes to Spain in 2029
items.summary: The Showlight conference, aimed at entertainment and architainment lighting professionals, will hold its 2029 edition in Granada, Spain, sponsored by Ayrton and SGM.

items.title: Thorn and Zumtobel light the future of learning at Coláiste na Mí
items.summary: Thorn and Zumtobel supplied a phased lighting installation across Coláiste na Mí's education campus, covering classrooms, social spaces and specialist facilities as part of a multi-building rollout.
